tool_input.command:
t=$(mktemp -d)
cd "$t"
mkdir -p dest
# 6 archives, keep 5: oldest must go, newest must stay (with sidecar)
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000 20260104-000000 20260105-000000 20260106-000000; do
  printf 'a\n' > "dest/demo-$s.tar.gz"; printf 'x  demo\n' > "dest/demo-$s.tar.gz.sha256"
done
R=/Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakh161p13-d
echo "--- dry-run (= form, --keep=5) ---"
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --dest=dest --name=demo --keep=5 -n
echo "--- real run ---"
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest dest --name demo --keep 5
ls dest | sort
echo "--- rc for unknown option ---"
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --dest dest --name demo --bogus 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- rc for bad --keep ---"
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --dest dest --name demo --keep abc 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- rc for missing --dest ---"
bash "$R/verify.sh" --name demo 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- rc for missing dir (resolve_dir die 2) ---"
bash "$R/verify.sh" --dest /nope 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- rotate --help exits 0 ---"
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --help >/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- verify --name filter + dry-run flag accepted ---"
bash "$R/verify.sh" --quiet --dest dest --name demo -n; echo "rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Sanity-check refactored rotate.sh and verify.sh flags and behavior
Remove temp check script and show changed files

result:
Changed `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh` and `tests/run_tests.sh`, and added `lib/common.sh` (all 8 tests pass).

Details:
- **rotate.sh**: `--keep N` now exits "nothing to rotate" when there are exactly N (`-lt` → `-le`), and surplus is computed as the first `total - keep` entries of the oldest-first list (`head -n "$((total - keep))"`) — previously `tail -n +"$keep"` cut from the newest end, which is why the newest archive was deleted.
- **verify.sh**: the sidecar line is now split on the first run of whitespace with a bash regex (`^([^[:space:]]+)[[:space:]]+(.+)$`), so a file name like `my backup-….tar.gz` survives intact — the old `awk '{print $2}'` truncated it to `my`, producing a false BAD; digest comparison is also quoted now.
- **lib/common.sh** (new): the identical option-parsing block (same flags: `--dest`, `--name`, `--keep`, `-q/--quiet`, `-n/--dry-run`, `-h/--help`, `--`, `parse_local_option` hook) and `resolve_dir`, with a double-sourcing guard; sourced by `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` only — `backup.sh`, `restore.sh` and `report.sh` are untouched.
- **tests/run_tests.sh**: added "verify reports ok for an intact archive whose name contains a space" and "rotate --keep N with exactly N archives deletes none (keeps the newest)", placed next to the existing verify/rotate coverage; both fail on the original code and pass now.

Note: a scratch check script remains at `/tmp/check_rotate_verify.sh`; deleting it was blocked as it's outside the working directory — feel free to remove it.
